community.title: Your Muslim Community on Campus
community.text: Muslim Students at KTH is a non-profit student association that provides a safe and welcoming space for Muslim students on campus. We believe university life is not only about academics, but also about belonging, faith, and meaningful connections. By joining MSKTH, you become part of a family where faith and friendship go hand in hand. We create opportunities for students to gather in prayer, share experiences, and participate in activities that strengthen both personal and academic growth.

AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.description: A space to grow in faith, knowledge, and community.

ourStory.intro: We strive to create a welcoming space where Muslim students can connect with each other, strengthen their relationship with God, and build lasting friendships on campus.
ourStory.mission: At Muslim Students KTH (MSKTH), we aim to create a space at KTH where faith and knowledge meet. A space that allows Muslim students to grow spiritually, academically, and socially, where one can feel both grounded in belief and at home in community.
ourStory.heading: Our story
ourStory.story: MSKTH was founded by students who saw a need for a supportive community where Muslim students could find strength and companionship in their daily life at university. Over time, what began as a few students meeting for prayer and discussion has grown into a vibrant association, a place for friendships, worship, learning, and service. Our journey continues with the same purpose: to be a trusted meeting point for all Muslim students at KTH.

Collaboration.title: For Companies
Collaboration.whoText: KTH Muslim Student Association is a vibrant and inclusive community of students dedicated to promoting diversity, understanding, unity, and equality. With a growing membership of enthusiastic individuals, we represent a pool of over 500 future talents and potential collaborators.
Collaboration.whyIntro: At MSKTH, we believe in the power of collaboration to drive innovation and positive change. By partnering with us, your organization gains access to:

talentedIndividuals.title: Talented Individuals:
talentedIndividuals.text: Our diverse membership base comprises students from various academic backgrounds, each with unique skills and perspectives. These are the individuals who could be your future colleagues or employees.

communityEngagement.title: Community Engagement:
communityEngagement.text: Align your brand with a community that values inclusivity, cultural understanding, and social responsibility.

monthlyEvents.title: Monthly Events:
monthlyEvents.text: We host engaging events every month, drawing a diverse crowd of 25 to 100 male and female participants. Your partnership with us ensures that your brand is prominently featured at every event.

onlinePresence.title: Online Presence:
onlinePresence.text: As a partner, your organization will be prominently showcased across our digital platforms, reaching a wide and engaged audience.
